cases.sentence: Когда они подходили к виноградникам Тимны, внезапно ему навстречу выскочил, рыча, ___.
cases.explain: «молодой лев» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But his father and his mother didn’t know that it was of Yahweh; for he sought an occasion against the Philistines. Now at that time the Philistines ruled over Israel.

cases.sentence: На Самсона стремительно сошел Дух Господа, и Самсон разорвал льва ___, точно козленка.
cases.explain: «голыми руками» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.

cases.explain: «пчелиный рой» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: After a while he returned to take her, and he went over to see the carcass of the lion; and behold, there was a swarm of bees in the body of the lion, and honey.

cases.sentence: Но он не сказал им о том, что взял мед из ___ .
cases.explain: «львиного трупа» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He took it into his hands, and went on, eating as he went. He came to his father and mother and gave to them, and they ate, but he didn’t tell them that he had taken the honey out of the lion’s body.

cases.sentence: Когда он показался там, ему выбрали тридцать ___, чтобы они были с ним.
cases.explain: «брачных друзей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

cases.sentence: А если не сможете разгадать, вы сами дадите мне тридцать одеяний из ___ и тридцать смен одежды.
cases.explain: «тонкого полотна» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: but if you can’t tell me the answer, then you shall give me thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothing.” They said to him, “Tell us your riddle, that we may hear it.”

cases.sentence: На ___ он, наконец, открыл ей, потому что она извела его.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: She wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted; and on the seventh day, he told her, because she pressed him severely; and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

cases.sentence: В ___, перед заходом солнца, жители города сказали ему:
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The men of the city said to him on the seventh day before the sun went down, “What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?” He said to them, “If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have found out my riddle.”

cases.sentence: А жену Самсона отдали его ___, который был его лучшим другом.
cases.explain: «свадебному дружке» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend.
